$Comment: What the pet menu says about each pet, in the order it lists them. rank: the supporter rank that gives the pet (its name and colour come from here); store pets have no rank and show their Crown Store price. membership: the pet stays only while that rank is held. moods: shown on the pet's page; leave empty for pets that float and have no moods. A pet in the collection but missing here is listed last with no description.

Pets.description: A round little hedgehog with leaves for spines. It trots along behind you and curls up for a nap when you stand still.
A tiny owl with starry feathers. It hops along behind you and blinks its big blue eyes when you stop.
A fluffy fox with soft moth wings. It floats beside you with a little glowing moon on the tip of its tail.
A smiling axolotl made of the night sky. Tiny planets circle it as it drifts along beside you.
A little crystal dragon inside a ring of glowing runes. It floats beside you for as long as you are an Eternal member.
A cheerful corn friend who waddles after you wherever you go.
The king of all corn, in a shiny golden crown. Popcorn bursts from his feet as he struts along behind you.
A little woodland sprout that drifts along beside you.
